_source: Batch 8 (26 Oct 2026): local guide for the 50 Panchang city pages. Every temple and festival line below was taken from the page in its 'source' field, opened with WebFetch on 26 Oct 2026 (Wikipedia, official temple / district / state-tourism sites, or the Government of India's Incredible India site). Nothing here is from memory. A city shows only what could be sourced; satellite cities have their own facts, not the parent city's. nameHi / lineHi = natural Hindi for the 10 cities that also have /hi/panchang/:city pages.

temples.name: Siddhivinayak Temple
temples.line: Ganesha temple in Prabhadevi, completed in 1801.
temples.lineHi: प्रभादेवी में गणेश जी का मंदिर, जो 1801 में बनकर पूरा हुआ।

temples.name: Mahalakshmi Temple
temples.line: Temple of the goddess Mahalakshmi on Bhulabhai Desai Marg; Navratri is among its festivals.
temples.lineHi: भूलाभाई देसाई मार्ग पर देवी महालक्ष्मी का मंदिर; यहाँ नवरात्रि प्रमुख उत्सवों में है।

temples.name: Walkeshwar Temple
temples.line: A 10th-century temple, listed among the city's surviving structures from the Shilahara period.
temples.lineHi: दसवीं सदी का मंदिर, जो शिलाहार काल की शहर में बची इमारतों में गिना जाता है।

festivals.name: Ganesh Chaturthi
festivals.line: The Lalbaugcha Raja, a public Ganesha idol kept at Lalbaug since 1934, is immersed in the Arabian Sea at Girgaon Chowpatty on Anant Chaturdashi.
festivals.lineHi: लालबाग में 1934 से विराजने वाले सार्वजनिक गणपति ‘लालबागचा राजा’ का अनंत चतुर्दशी पर गिरगाँव चौपाटी पर अरब सागर में विसर्जन होता है।

festivals.name: Navratri
festivals.line: Celebrated at the Mahalakshmi Temple.
festivals.lineHi: महालक्ष्मी मंदिर में धूमधाम से मनाई जाती है।

temples.name: Laxminarayan Temple
temples.line: Hindu temple inaugurated by Mahatma Gandhi in 1933.
temples.lineHi: हिन्दू मंदिर, जिसका उद्घाटन 1933 में महात्मा गांधी ने किया था।

temples.name: Akshardham
temples.line: Cited, with the Laxminarayan Temple, as an example of the city's modern architecture.
temples.lineHi: लक्ष्मीनारायण मंदिर के साथ, दिल्ली की आधुनिक स्थापत्य कला के उदाहरण के रूप में गिना जाता है।

temples.name: Yogmaya Temple
temples.line: Temple in Mehrauli.
temples.lineHi: महरौली में स्थित मंदिर।

festivals.name: Vasant Panchami
festivals.line: The spring festival, held every year in Delhi.
festivals.lineHi: वसंत का त्योहार, जो दिल्ली में हर साल मनाया जाता है।

festivals.name: Phool Walon Ki Sair
festivals.line: The flower sellers' annual festival in Mehrauli, with a procession of floral fans to the Yogmaya Temple and a Sufi dargah, usually in September.
festivals.lineHi: महरौली में फूल वालों का सालाना उत्सव, जिसमें फूलों के पंखों की शोभायात्रा योगमाया मंदिर और एक सूफ़ी दरगाह तक जाती है; आमतौर पर सितंबर में।

temples.name: Begur Nageshwara Temple
temples.line: Commissioned around 860 CE, in the time of the Western Ganga kings.
temples.lineHi: लगभग 860 ईस्वी में पश्चिमी गंग राजाओं के समय बनवाया गया मंदिर।

temples.name: Basavanagudi temple
temples.line: Built by Kempe Gowda.
temples.lineHi: केम्पे गौड़ा द्वारा बनवाया गया मंदिर।

temples.name: Halasuru Someshwara Temple
temples.line: Its idol is the centre of the city's annual Someshwara car festival.
temples.lineHi: शहर के वार्षिक सोमेश्वर रथोत्सव का केंद्र इसी मंदिर की प्रतिमा है।

festivals.name: Bangalore Karaga
festivals.line: Also called Karaga Shaktyotsava, a festival dedicated to the goddess Draupadi.
festivals.lineHi: करगा शक्त्योत्सव भी कहलाता है; देवी द्रौपदी को समर्पित उत्सव।

festivals.name: Someshwara car festival
festivals.line: Held every April at the Halasuru Someshwara Temple.
festivals.lineHi: हर साल अप्रैल में हलसूरु सोमेश्वर मंदिर में होता है।

temples.name: Birla Mandir
temples.line: Temple of Lord Venkateswara on the Naubath Pahad hillock, opened in 1976.
temples.lineHi: नौबत पहाड़ की पहाड़ी पर भगवान वेंकटेश्वर का मंदिर, 1976 में खुला।

temples.name: Chilkur Balaji Temple
temples.line: Balaji temple on the banks of Osman Sagar, also called 'Visa' Balaji.
temples.lineHi: उस्मान सागर के किनारे बालाजी का मंदिर, जिसे ‘वीज़ा बालाजी’ भी कहते हैं।

temples.name: Ujjaini Mahakali Temple
temples.line: Mahakali temple in Secunderabad, central to Bonalu.
temples.lineHi: सिकंदराबाद का महाकाली मंदिर, बोनालु का एक प्रमुख केंद्र।

festivals.name: Bonalu
festivals.line: Festival of the goddess Mahakali in the month of Ashada (June–August), celebrated across Hyderabad and Secunderabad.
festivals.lineHi: आषाढ़ मास (जून–अगस्त) में देवी महाकाली का उत्सव, जो पूरे हैदराबाद और सिकंदराबाद में मनाया जाता है।

festivals.name: Ganesh Chaturthi (Khairatabad Ganesh)
festivals.line: A tall Ganesha idol set up in Khairatabad every year since 1954, immersed in Hussain Sagar after the festival.
festivals.lineHi: खैरताबाद में 1954 से हर साल स्थापित होने वाली ऊँची गणेश प्रतिमा, जिसका उत्सव के बाद हुसैन सागर में विसर्जन होता है।

temples.name: Kapaleeshwarar Temple
temples.line: Shiva temple in Mylapore.
temples.lineHi: मायलापुर में भगवान शिव का मंदिर।

temples.name: Parthasarathy Temple
temples.line: 6th-century Vishnu temple in Triplicane.
temples.lineHi: ट्रिप्लिकेन में छठी सदी का भगवान विष्णु का मंदिर।

festivals.name: Arupathimoovar festival
festivals.line: The Kapaleeshwarar temple's best-known festival, in the Tamil month of Panguni.
festivals.lineHi: कपालीश्वरर मंदिर का सबसे प्रसिद्ध उत्सव, तमिल मास पंगुनी में।

festivals.name: Vaikunta Ekadashi
festivals.line: The most important festival at the Parthasarathy Temple.
festivals.lineHi: पार्थसारथी मंदिर का सबसे महत्वपूर्ण उत्सव।

temples.name: Jagannath Temple
temples.line: Temple of Lord Jagannath, known for its annual Rath Yatra.
temples.lineHi: भगवान जगन्नाथ का मंदिर, जो अपनी वार्षिक रथ यात्रा के लिए जाना जाता है।

temples.name: Bhadrakali Temple
temples.line: At Manek Chowk; Ma Bhadrakali is believed to be the guardian deity of the city.
temples.lineHi: माणेक चौक पर; माँ भद्रकाली को शहर की रक्षक देवी माना जाता है।

festivals.name: Rath Yatra
festivals.line: Chariot procession on Asadh Sud Bij, organised by the Jagannath Temple since 1878.
festivals.lineHi: आषाढ़ सुद बीज को निकलने वाली रथ यात्रा, जिसे जगन्नाथ मंदिर 1878 से आयोजित करता है।

festivals.name: Uttarayan
festivals.line: The International Kite Festival on 14–15 January, linked to Makar Sankranti; Ahmedabad is called the kite capital of Gujarat.
festivals.lineHi: 14–15 जनवरी को अंतरराष्ट्रीय पतंग उत्सव, मकर संक्रांति से जुड़ा; अहमदाबाद को गुजरात की ‘पतंग राजधानी’ कहा जाता है।

festivals.name: Navratri
festivals.line: Garba and raas through the nine nights; the Bhadrakali Temple sees especially large crowds.
festivals.lineHi: नौ रातों तक गरबा और रास; इन दिनों भद्रकाली मंदिर में विशेष भीड़ रहती है।

temples.name: Dakshineswar Kali Temple
temples.line: Temple of Bhavatarini (Kali) on the eastern bank of the Hooghly, built by Rani Rashmoni in 1855.
temples.lineHi: हुगली के पूर्वी तट पर भवतारिणी (काली) का मंदिर, जिसे रानी रासमणि ने 1855 में बनवाया।

temples.name: Kalighat Temple
temples.line: Temple of the goddess Kali, one of the 51 Shakti Pithas.
temples.lineHi: देवी काली का मंदिर, 51 शक्तिपीठों में से एक।

festivals.name: Durga Puja
festivals.line: The city's largest festival; some 3,000 pandals go up across Kolkata and its suburbs.
festivals.lineHi: शहर का सबसे बड़ा उत्सव; कोलकाता और उपनगरों में लगभग 3,000 पंडाल सजते हैं।

festivals.name: Kali Puja
festivals.line: Coincides with Diwali; Kali is worshipped at night in thousands of pandals, homes and temples.
festivals.lineHi: दीवाली के साथ पड़ती है; हज़ारों पंडालों, घरों और मंदिरों में रात को माँ काली की पूजा होती है।

festivals.name: Chand Padvo
festivals.line: Celebrated by Surtis on the biggest full-moon day of the Hindu calendar; described as unique to the city.

festivals.name: Navratri
festivals.line: Described as the most important festival in Surat.

festivals.name: Uttarayan
festivals.line: The kite-flying festival, celebrated with great pomp.

temples.name: Kasba Ganapati
temples.line: With Tambadi Jogeshwari, considered a guardian deity of the city; Jijabai is said to have commissioned the temple.
temples.lineHi: ताम्बडी जोगेश्वरी के साथ शहर के रक्षक देवता माने जाते हैं; मंदिर जिजाबाई ने बनवाया बताया जाता है।

temples.name: Dagadusheth Halwai Ganapati Temple
temples.line: Described as the richest Ganesh temple in Pune.
temples.lineHi: पुणे का सबसे समृद्ध गणेश मंदिर बताया जाता है।

temples.name: Pataleshwar
temples.line: An old rock-cut temple complex in the city.
temples.lineHi: शहर में चट्टान काटकर बना पुराना मंदिर-समूह।

temples.name: Parvati temple complex
temples.line: Temple complex on Parvati Hill.
temples.lineHi: पर्वती पहाड़ी पर स्थित मंदिर-समूह।

festivals.name: Ganesh Chaturthi
festivals.line: Widely and publicly celebrated, with pandals across the city and Dhol-Tasha processions; Lokmanya Tilak started the public celebration.
festivals.lineHi: पूरे शहर में पंडाल और ढोल-ताशा के साथ सार्वजनिक रूप से मनाई जाती है; सार्वजनिक उत्सव की शुरुआत लोकमान्य तिलक ने की थी।

festivals.name: Diwali Pahat
festivals.line: The 'Diwali dawn' music concerts originated in Pune.
festivals.lineHi: दीवाली की भोर के संगीत कार्यक्रम ‘दिवाळी पहाट’ की शुरुआत पुणे से हुई।

temples.name: Govind Dev Ji Temple
temples.line: Temple of Radha and Krishna within the City Palace complex.
temples.lineHi: सिटी पैलेस परिसर के भीतर राधा-कृष्ण का मंदिर।

temples.name: Galtaji
temples.line: Ancient Hindu pilgrimage site about 10 km east of Jaipur.
temples.lineHi: जयपुर से लगभग 10 किमी पूर्व में प्राचीन हिन्दू तीर्थ।

festivals.name: Gangaur
festivals.line: A procession with the image of Gauri starts from the Zanani-Deodhi of the City Palace; the festival begins the day after Holi and runs for 16 days.
festivals.lineHi: गौरी की प्रतिमा के साथ शोभायात्रा सिटी पैलेस की ज़नानी ड्योढ़ी से निकलती है; उत्सव होली के अगले दिन से 16 दिन चलता है।

festivals.name: Janmashtami
festivals.line: One of the major festivals at the Govind Dev Ji Temple.
festivals.lineHi: गोविंद देव जी मंदिर के प्रमुख उत्सवों में से एक।

festivals.name: Makar Sankranti
festivals.line: Thousands visit Galtaji for a holy dip.
festivals.lineHi: हज़ारों लोग स्नान के लिए गलताजी पहुँचते हैं।

temples.name: Chandrika Devi Temple
temples.line: Temple of a form of the goddess Durga, on the Gomti at Bakshi Ka Talab.
temples.lineHi: बख्शी का तालाब में गोमती के किनारे देवी दुर्गा के एक रूप का मंदिर।

temples.name: Hanuman Mandir, Aliganj
temples.line: Linked to Aliya Begum, wife of Nawab Shuja-ud-Daula; the centre of the Bade Mangal Mela.
temples.lineHi: नवाब शुजाउद्दौला की बेगम आलिया से जुड़ा मंदिर; बड़े मंगल मेले का केंद्र।

temples.name: Sankat Mochan Hanuman Temple
temples.line: Hanuman temple in the city.
temples.lineHi: शहर का हनुमान मंदिर।

festivals.name: Bada Mangal
festivals.line: Every Tuesday of Jyeshtha (usually May–June); the most prominent local festival of the year in Lucknow.
festivals.lineHi: ज्येष्ठ मास (आमतौर पर मई–जून) का हर मंगलवार; लखनऊ का साल का सबसे प्रमुख स्थानीय पर्व।

festivals.name: Navratri
festivals.line: Among the festivals at the Chandrika Devi Temple.
festivals.lineHi: चंद्रिका देवी मंदिर के उत्सवों में शामिल।

temples.name: JK Temple
temples.line: Radha-Krishna temple in Sarvodaya Nagar, built by the JK Trust of the Singhania family.

temples.name: Brahma temple, Brahmavart Ghat
temples.line: A small temple of Lord Brahma on the Ganga at Bithoor, in Kanpur district.

festivals.name: Ganga Mela
festivals.line: An extension of Holi, held in memory of a 1942 protest against a British ban on Holi.

festivals.name: Kartik Poornima
festivals.line: Observed at Brahmavart Ghat in Bithoor (November–December).

temples.name: Tekdi Ganesh Mandir
temples.line: Called the most famous temple in Nagpur, near the railway station; regarded as Swayambhu (self-manifested).

temples.name: Koradi Devi Temple
temples.line: Shree Mahalaxmi Jagdamba temple at Koradi near Nagpur, considered one of the Shakti peeths.

temples.name: Ramtek Fort Temple
temples.line: A temple built inside a fort at Ramtek.

festivals.name: Marbat
festivals.line: A festival unique to Nagpur, held the day after the bullock festival of Pola; the black and yellow Marbat processions began in 1880.

temples.name: Khajrana Ganesh Temple
temples.line: Ganesha temple in Khajrana, built in 1735 by Maharani Ahilyabai Holkar.

temples.name: Annapurna Temple
temples.line: A well-known temple of the goddess Annapurna.

temples.name: Bada Ganpati Temple
temples.line: Known for its 25-ft idol of Ganesha made of bricks and limestone.

festivals.name: Gair on Rangpanchami
festivals.line: The Holi procession that winds around Rajwada a few days after Holi, a tradition dating to the Holkar rulers.

festivals.name: Navratri at Bijasan Mata Temple
festivals.line: Daily rituals and celebrations at the Bijasan Mata Temple through Navratri.

temples.name: Kopineshwar Mandir
temples.line: Shiva temple built by the Shilahara dynasty and rebuilt in 1760, beside Masunda Lake.

temples.name: Mahadev Dhyan Mandir
temples.line: A shrine at the centre of Masunda Lake (Talao Pali).

temples.name: Ganesha temple, Upvan Lake
temples.line: Ganesha temple built by Singhania at Upvan Lake.

festivals.name: Ganeshotsav
festivals.line: On the final day, thousands of Ganpati idols are brought to Upvan Lake for immersion.

temples.name: Bhojeshwar Temple
temples.line: Shiva temple at Bhojpur, 28 km from Bhopal, begun under the Paramara king Bhoja in the 11th century; it houses a 7.5-ft lingam.

temples.name: Lakshmi Narayan Temple (Birla Mandir)
temples.line: Near the Arera Hills, built by the Birla family and completed in 1964.

temples.name: Curfew Wali Mata Temple
temples.line: Established during Navratri in 1981; named after a curfew imposed during a dispute over the idol's installation.

festivals.name: Maha Shivaratri
festivals.line: Thousands of devotees visit the Bhojeshwar Temple.

temples.name: Simhachalam Temple
temples.line: Temple of Vishnu as Varaha Narasimha, about ten miles north of the city.

temples.name: Kanaka Maha Lakshmi Temple
temples.line: Temple of the goddess Lakshmi in Burujupeta.

temples.name: Venkateswara Temple, Ross Hill
temples.line: Built by Capt. Blackmoor in 1886.

festivals.name: Chandanotsava
festivals.line: Held at Simhachalam on Akshaya Tritiya (April–May).

festivals.name: Margasira Masa Mahotsavam
festivals.line: A month-long festival at the Kanaka Mahalakshmi temple.

temples.name: Khandoba Mandir, Akurdi
temples.line: Temple of Khandoba, the family deity of most Marathi Hindus.

temples.name: Vaishno Devi Temple, Pimpri
temples.line: A Vaishno Devi temple in Pimpri.

festivals.name: Bhairavnath fair, Bhosari
festivals.line: Perhaps the best-known village fair in the city.

festivals.name: Ganeshotsav
festivals.line: Among the festivals celebrated across all communities in the city.

temples.name: Mahavir Mandir
temples.line: Hanuman temple that draws huge crowds on Ram Navami.

temples.name: Patan Devi
temples.line: The oldest temple of Patna, regarded as one of the 51 Siddha Shakta pithas.

festivals.name: Ram Navami
festivals.line: The busiest day at Mahavir Mandir.

festivals.name: Vijayadashami mela
festivals.line: A fair is held near the Patan Devi temples at Vijayadashami.

temples.name: EME Temple
temples.line: Shiva temple built in 1966 by the Army's EME School.

temples.name: Kirti Mandir
temples.line: A cluster of Shiva temples that is also the Gaekwad royal family's cenotaph.

festivals.name: Navratri
festivals.line: The United Way of Baroda Garba Mahotsav is held on a grand scale through the nine nights.

temples.name: Dudheshwar Nath Mandir
temples.line: An ancient Shiva temple, with Shiva in lingam form.

temples.name: Mahamaya Temple, Modinagar
temples.line: Temple of the Mother Goddess in Sikri Khurd village, Modinagar.

festivals.name: Navratri
festivals.line: A large gathering for the Mother Goddess is held every year at the Mahamaya Temple.

temples.name: Shri Krishna Mandir
temples.line: A must-visit temple of the city.

temples.name: Shri Ayappa Temple
temples.line: Dedicated to Lord Ayappa, with four more shrines to Shiva, Ganesh, Vishnu and Devi Mata.

festivals.name: Janmashtami
festivals.line: Celebrated at the Shri Krishna Mandir, as are Dussehra and Shivratri.

temples.name: Mankameshwar Temple
temples.line: Ancient Shiva temple at Rawatpara, near Agra Fort railway station.

temples.name: Bateshwar
temples.line: A chain of 101 riverside temples, mainly of Shiva, about 70 km from Agra.

festivals.name: Bateshwar Fair
festivals.line: A month-long fair around Kartik Purnima (October–November).

temples.name: Trimbakeshwar Temple
temples.line: Shiva temple about 28 km from Nashik, one of the twelve Jyotirlinga shrines.

temples.name: Kalaram Mandir
temples.line: Site of the 1930 Nashik Satyagraha, led by B. R. Ambedkar for the entry of Dalits into the temple.

festivals.name: Simhastha Kumbh Mela
festivals.line: Held once every 12 years, with ritual bathing in the Godavari at Nashik and Trimbak; the next one is listed for 2026–27.

festivals.name: Rama Navami
festivals.line: Among the festivals of the Kalaram Temple at Panchavati, with Navaratri and Diwali.

temples.name: Shri Maharani Vaishno Devi Mandir
temples.line: Vaishno Devi temple at Tikona Park.

temples.name: Jagannath Temple
temples.line: Jagannath temple in Sector 15A.

temples.name: Surajkund
temples.line: A masonry tank from about the 10th century where a Sun temple is believed to have once stood.

temples.name: Augarhnath (Kali Paltan) Mandir
temples.line: Shiva temple near the army barracks, founded after a Shivalinga was found in 1844; its well is where sepoys of the 1857 uprising met.

temples.name: Chandi Devi Mandir, Nauchandi
temples.line: Old temple of the goddess Chandi at the edge of the Nauchandi Ground.

festivals.name: Nauchandi Mela
festivals.line: Annual fair at the Nauchandi Ground from the second Sunday after Holi, held to worship the goddess Chandi in Chaitra Navratri.

festivals.name: Kanwar Yatra
festivals.line: Pilgrims carry Ganga water to the Augharnath temple during Sawan.

temples.name: BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir
temples.line: On Kalawad Road, about 4 km from Rajkot Junction.

temples.name: Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Rajkot
temples.line: Temple of Laxminarayan Dev, HariKrishna Maharaj and Ghanshyam Maharaj, under the LaxmiNarayan Dev Gadi.

festivals.name: Janmashtami Mela
festivals.line: A five-day fair at the Race Course grounds.

festivals.name: Navaratri
festivals.line: Nine nights of Shakti worship with garba.

temples.name: Durgadi Mata Temple
temples.line: A small temple of the goddess Durga in Durgadi Fort, Kalyan; the fort is named after her.

temples.name: Siddhivinayak Mahaganapati Temple, Titwala
temples.line: Ganesha temple in Titwala, a town near Kalyan; busiest on Ganesh Chaturthi and Angarki Sankashti Chaturthi.

festivals.name: Navaratri at Durgadi
festivals.line: The Navaratri celebrations at the fort temple draw devotees from Mumbai, Thane, Raigad and Palghar.

festivals.name: Gudi Padwa
festivals.line: The Marathi New Year; a festive procession in Dombivli is pictured in the source.

temples.name: Jivdani Mata Temple
temples.line: Shrine of the goddess Jivdani on the top of the hill at Virar.

temples.name: Tungareshwar Temple
temples.line: Shiva temple at Vasai.

festivals.name: Navratri
festivals.line: Many devotees climb to the Jivdani Mata shrine during the nine days.

festivals.name: Maha Shivratri
festivals.line: Celebrated at the Tungareshwar Temple, as is the month of Shraavana.

temples.name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple
temples.line: Shiva temple in Vishwanath Gali, one of the twelve Jyotirlinga shrines.

temples.name: Sankat Mochan Hanuman Temple
temples.line: Hanuman temple on the banks of the Assi river, established by the poet-saint Tulsidas.

festivals.name: Dev Deepawali
festivals.line: Celebrated on Kartik Purnima, fifteen days after Diwali, along the ghats from Assi Ghat to Raj Ghat.

festivals.name: Rangbhari Ekadashi
festivals.line: Twelve days after Maha Shivaratri, marking Shiva's return to Kashi with Parvati.

festivals.name: Maha Shivaratri
festivals.line: The main festival of the Kashi Vishwanath Temple.

temples.name: Shankaracharya Temple
temples.line: Shiva temple on top of the Zabarwan Range.

temples.name: Kheer Bhawani Temple
temples.line: Temple of the goddess Ragnya Devi at Tulmulla, about 25 km north-east of Srinagar.

festivals.name: Kheer Bhawani mela
festivals.line: The annual gathering of Kashmiri Hindus at the temple on Jyeshtha Ashtami.

festivals.name: Herath (Maha Shivaratri)
festivals.line: Kashmiri Hindus visit the Shankaracharya Temple, which is lit up for the occasion.

temples.name: Ghrishneshwar Temple
temples.line: One of the twelve Jyotirlinga temples, about 30 km north-west of the city; rebuilt in 1729 with the support of Queen Gautama Bai Holkar.

temples.name: Kailasa Temple, Ellora
temples.line: The largest rock-cut Hindu temple at Ellora, a Shiva shrine believed to be carved from a single rock; generally attributed to the 8th-century Rashtrakuta king Krishna I.

temples.name: Bhadra Maruti Temple, Khuldabad
temples.line: Hanuman temple about 4 km from the Ellora Caves, with Hanuman in a reclining posture.

festivals.name: Hanuman Jayanti and Ram Navami
festivals.line: The main festivals at the Bhadra Maruti Temple, when large crowds visit.

festivals.name: Shravan Saturdays
festivals.line: Visits to Bhadra Maruti peak on Saturdays in the month of Shravan.

temples.name: Gayatri Gyan Mandir, Mahuda
temples.line: Temple of the goddess Gayatri at Mahuda in Dhanbad district, completed in 2004.

temples.name: Rani Sati Mandir, Mahuda
temples.line: Hindu temple in the Mahuda area of Dhanbad district.

festivals.name: Gayatri Jayanti
festivals.line: Among the festivals at the Gayatri Gyan Mandir, with Navratri and Maha Shivaratri.

temples.name: Durgiana Temple
temples.line: Temple named after the goddess Durga, its chief deity.

temples.name: Ram Tirath
temples.line: About 12 km west of Amritsar on Chogawan road; many visit at its annual fair.

festivals.name: Langur Mela
festivals.line: Held at the Durgiana Temple during the ten days of Navratri and Dussehra.

temples.name: ISKCON Kharghar
temples.line: The first ISKCON temple in Navi Mumbai (Sri Radha Madan Mohanji), about 5 km from the Navi Mumbai Airport.

temples.name: Amruthaishwar temple
temples.line: An old temple near Belapur Fort, mentioned in the fort's history.

festivals.name: Ganeshotsav
festivals.line: Chincholi Talao in Juinagar is a place for immersing idols.

festivals.name: Navratri
festivals.line: Garba raas is a major attraction of Navratri in Juinagar.

temples.name: Bade Hanuman Mandir
temples.line: Near the Triveni Sangam, known for its reclining idol of Hanuman.

temples.name: Alopi Devi Mandir
temples.line: At Alopibagh near the Sangam; a wooden doli is worshipped here instead of an idol.

festivals.name: Magh Mela
festivals.line: Held every year on the banks of the Triveni Sangam in the Hindu month of Magh (about mid-January to mid-February).

festivals.name: Kumbh Mela
festivals.line: The full Kumbh is held every 12 years at the Sangam; the last Maha Kumbh ran from 13 January to 26 February 2025.

temples.name: Belur Math
temples.line: Headquarters of the Ramakrishna Math and Mission, a complex of temples in Belur, a neighbourhood of Howrah.

temples.name: Hajar Haat Kali Temple, Shibpur
temples.line: Famed for its rare thousand-handed Kali idol; established around 1870–80.

temples.name: Bangeshwar Mahadev Temple, Salkia
temples.line: Shiva shrine by the Hooghly with a 51-foot, five-headed Shiva statue unveiled in 2015.

festivals.name: Ramrajatala puja fair
festivals.line: Begins on Ram Navami at the Ramrajatala Ram Mandir and runs nearly four months to Shravan's last Sunday; called Bengal's longest-running puja fair.

festivals.name: Rash Utsav, Belur Rash Bari
festivals.line: Radha-Krishna festival with idol processions, kirtans and feasts.

temples.name: Jagannath Temple
temples.line: On a hillock about 10 km from the main town; the original temple was finished in 1691.

temples.name: Pahari Mandir
temples.line: Shiva temple on top of a hill in Ranchi.

temples.name: Deori Mandir
temples.line: At Deori village, Tamar, near Ranchi, with a 700-year-old sixteen-handed idol of the goddess.

festivals.name: Rath Yatra
festivals.line: Annual fair at the Jagannath Temple in Aashaadha, modelled on Puri's car festival.

festivals.name: Shivaratri
festivals.line: A key gathering day at the Pahari Mandir.

temples.name: Chausath Yogini Temple, Bhedaghat
temples.line: Early-11th-century circular Yogini temple on a hilltop above the Narmada at Bhedaghat.

temples.name: Gwarighat
temples.line: Ghat on the Narmada with a half-submerged temple of Maa Narmada, known for its aarti.

temples.name: Tilwadeshwar temple
temples.line: Near Tilwara Ghat, where Gandhi's ashes were immersed.

festivals.name: Narmada Jayanti
festivals.line: Celebrated at Gwarighat with a Shobhayatra, devotional singing at the ghats and an evening Maha Aarti.

festivals.name: Kartik fair, Gwarighat
festivals.line: A huge fair is held at Gwarighat during the month of Kartik.

temples.name: Teli ka Mandir
temples.line: Temple in Gwalior Fort dated to the 8th–9th century, dedicated to Shiva, Vishnu and the Matrikas.

temples.name: Sasbahu Temples
temples.line: Pair of temples in the fort built in 1090–1093 by King Mahipala.

temples.name: Chaturbhuj Temple
temples.line: Rock-cut shrine in Gwalior Fort (876 CE). Wikipedia notes its inscription has one of the earliest known zeros carved in stone; older texts such as the Bakhshali manuscript use zero.

temples.name: Achleshwar Mahadev Temple
temples.line: A Shiva temple in Gwalior, about 300 years old.

festivals.name: Navratri at Mandre Mata Temple
festivals.line: The Mandre Mata Temple draws devotees during Navratri.

temples.name: Perur Pateeswarar Temple
temples.line: Shiva temple at Perur on the Noyyal river, said to have been built by the Chola emperor Karikala.

temples.name: Marudhamalai Temple
temples.line: Murugan temple on a hillock on the city's outskirts, in the Western Ghats.

festivals.name: Panguni Uthiram
festivals.line: Celebrated every year at Perur with the temple chariot taken through the neighbourhood.

festivals.name: Thai Poosam
festivals.line: Celebrated at Marudhamalai (January–February).

temples.name: Kanaka Durga Temple
temples.line: Temple of Kanaka Durga on the Indrakeeladri hill, on the banks of the Krishna.

temples.name: Malleswara temple
temples.line: At the foot of the Indrakeeladri hills.

festivals.name: Dasara
festivals.line: Durga Pooja and a special Theppotsavam (boat festival) on the Krishna are important events of Dasara in the city.

festivals.name: Krishna Pushkaram
festivals.line: The city is the ritual host of the Pushkaram of the River Krishna.

temples.name: Chamunda Mata Temple
temples.line: By the southern gate of Mehrangarh Fort; Rao Jodha brought the goddess here from Mandore.

temples.name: Raj Ranchhodji Temple
temples.line: Houses a black marble image of Ranchhodji.

temples.name: Achal Nath Shivalaya
temples.line: A prominent Shiva temple of the city.

festivals.name: Navratra
festivals.line: Lakhs of devotees visit Chamunda Mata; an annual yagna is held on Ashtami.

festivals.name: Dussehra
festivals.line: Crowds throng Mehrangarh during the Dussehra celebrations.

temples.name: Meenakshi Temple
temples.line: On the southern bank of the Vaigai, dedicated to Meenakshi (a form of Parvati) and Sundareswarar.

temples.name: Thiruparankundram Murugan Temple
temples.line: On a hillock 8 km from Madurai, the first of Murugan's six abodes.

festivals.name: Chithirai festival (Meenakshi Tirukalyanam)
festivals.line: In the Tamil month of Chithirai; its second half follows Kallazhagar's journey and the event in the Vaigai river.

festivals.name: Float festival
festivals.line: Held in January–February at the Vandiyur Mariamman Teppakulam, one of the largest temple ponds in South India.

temples.name: Mahamaya Temple
temples.line: Temple of Devi Mahamaya at Purani Basti, renovated in the 17th–18th century.

temples.name: Dudhadhari Math
temples.line: Founded by Swami Balabhadradas, a 16th-century monk.

festivals.name: Navaratri
festivals.line: Observed at the Mahamaya Temple, with Durga Ashtami and Vijayadashami.

temples.name: Godawari Dham
temples.line: Hanuman temple on the banks of the Chambal river in Kota.

temples.name: Kansua Shiva temple
temples.line: Shiva temple a few kilometres outside Kota; an inscription on its wall dates its building to 738 CE.

festivals.name: Kota Dussehra Mela
festivals.line: Held at the Dussehra Ground, with Ravana effigies up to 75 feet, cultural evenings and festive markets.

festivals.name: Hanuman Jayanti
festivals.line: The biggest day at Godawari Dham, with large crowds and lamps floated on the Chambal at night.

temples.name: Mata Mansa Devi Mandir
temples.line: In Panchkula, about 10 km from the Chandigarh bus terminus; the main temple was built in 1811–1815.

temples.name: Chandi Mandir
temples.line: Temple of the goddess Chandi about 15 km from the city, which was named after it.

festivals.name: Navratra Mela
festivals.line: Nine-day melas at Mansa Devi twice a year, in Ashvin and Chaitra.

temples.name: Kamakhya Temple
temples.line: Temple of the goddess Kamakhya on the Nilachal hills, among the oldest of the 51 Shakta pithas.

temples.name: Umananda Temple
temples.line: Shiva temple on Umananda (Peacock) Island in the Brahmaputra, built in 1694 under the Ahom king Gadadhar Singha.

festivals.name: Ambubachi Mela
festivals.line: Annual gathering at the Kamakhya Temple around the middle of June.

festivals.name: Maha Shivaratri
festivals.line: The main festival of the Umananda Temple.

temples.name: Siddheshwar Temple
temples.line: Temple of Shri Siddheshwar, with a lake within the temple complex.

temples.name: Manacha Shri Ajoba Ganpati
temples.line: One of the oldest Ganesh temples, celebrating the Ganesh festival since 1885.

festivals.name: Gadda Yatra
festivals.line: A fifteen-day fair near the Siddheshwar Temple from Makar Sankranti.

temples.name: Chandramauleshwara Temple, Unkal
temples.line: 11th-century Shiva temple from the Kalyani Chalukya era.

temples.name: Bhavani Shankar Temple
temples.line: Called the oldest temple in the city; an inscription dates its founding to the 11th century.

temples.name: Siddharoodha Math
temples.line: A major spiritual centre in Hubballi, visited throughout the year.
